newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Carcass Basis (weight only) compared Friday's close - slaughter steers and heifers not tested.

Steers - Select to mostly choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 108.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
